statement_summary: Maintain a documented security program
Annual risk assessment using SP 800-30
Risk decision rules; unsafe-product risks never accepted at High
Annual control evaluation with outside review every second year
Requirements register reviewed yearly; P03 rerun before game, sales, or retail
Annual policy review; written, time-limited exceptions
Owner's own accounts; no shared credentials
MFA on every account that offers it
Unique 14-character passphrases in a password manager; no browser storage
Default passwords and PINs changed before use
Standard user account for daily laptop work
View-only role for the second alert contact; vendor support only per session
Smokehouse remote program editing off; changes at the panel only
Monthly (weekly in season) review of logs, connected devices, and smokehouse programs
Sealed emergency envelope with recovery codes and cooler sheet
Vendor list with criticality and security contact
Shop security contact registered with every vendor
Minimum vendor checks before purchase or renewal; annual SOC 2 review
Export, delete, and close when a service is dropped
Three-level data classification
Restricted data only in approved locations
Encryption on every laptop and phone
Paper records in a locked box
Versioned file plan, monthly encrypted export, quarterly restore test, printed programs and summary
Retention for the 9 CFR 320.3 period; shredding and wiping with a log entry
Records producible at the shop during business hours
Updates, antivirus, official software; quarterly firmware check
Guest network for customers; separate device network
Required device settings listed and checked monthly
Payment changes confirmed by phone
Annual security training
No customer details in AI tools; cure amounts never from an AI tool; check recorded on the batch sheet
Incident runbook with printed contacts
Same-day incident log with discovery time
Hold product first when temperatures, programs, or cure may be affected
Notices per the P08 matrix, confirmed by counsel
No ransom without counsel and an OFAC check
Hourly manual temperature readings when alerts are down
Storm procedure
Battery backup for gateway and router; offline notice on
